prereg.win_rule: v13 primary metric lower than control in >=4/5 seeds, for every control

meta.primary: mean per-step parameter error over the noisy and shift phases

homeostasis.primary: mean over paths of the time-averaged parameter error after the pre-phase

claim_limit: synthetic open-loop streams, linear NLMS learners (dim 4), no language model, BOOT knob values
